A warrior gave up his own head, and Krishna gave him his own name. As the story goes, before the great war, a young warrior named Barbarik walked to Kurukshetra with just three arrows.
But those three arrows could end the entire war in one minute. And he had promised his mother, I will always fight for the side that is losing. Krishna knew what that meant.

Whichever side he joined would start winning, so he would switch, again and again, until no one was left. Wait, what did Krishna do? He asked Barbarik for a gift. His head. And Barbarik gave it, smiling.

Krishna placed his head on a hilltop to watch the whole war, and blessed him. In the age to come, you will be worshipped by my name. Shyam. That's why millions pray to Khatu Shyam. Comment Haare ka Sahara.
